paper.title: Soil carbon gains after winter cover cropping

paper_text:
Soil carbon gains after winter cover cropping
Haugen, S., Rao, V.  J. Fake Agronomy, 2018

Abstract
Winter cover crops raised topsoil carbon by 6% over three years.

Methods
Soil carbon was measured by dry combustion on cores taken at 0-15 cm using the sampling protocol in Section 2.
